findings.summary: Input baseline provenance is not pinned by the authoritative input map.
findings.evidence: known_inputs pins only ref_kind and digest, so an input can be reassociated with another current baseline and still PASS.
findings.required_fix: Pin exact task_id and baseline_digest in every authoritative known-input entry and add multi-baseline swap regressions.

findings.summary: The mutation gate self-reports group subcases rather than mechanically binding each subcase to an oracle.
findings.evidence: Coverage calls group tests then copies every declared subcase into executed; an injected declaration can pass without a fixture.
findings.required_fix: Bind every subcase to an exact independently dispatched probe/oracle and reject unimplemented declarations.
